algebra_verified.note_on_earlier_truncation: a first pass summed k*P(K=k) only to k=11 and returned 1089/455; including k=12 restores E[K] = 12/5 exactly, as linearity of expectation requires. Recorded rather than silently corrected.
algebra_verified.derivation: K >= k iff the top k of the 16 combined order statistics are all fresh, so P(K>=k) = prod_{i=0}^{k-1} (12-i)/(16-i). k=3 gives (12/16)(11/15)(10/14) = 165/420 = 11/28.
assumptions: continuous marginals, ties have probability zero
tube = max of the 4 calibration scores
no selection of the calibration set using outcomes
algebra_verified.what_this_does_NOT_establish: three historical exceedances among twelve are entirely ordinary under exchangeability: E[K] = 2.4 and P(K >= 3) = 11/28 ~ 0.393. They therefore do not by themselves establish population non-transfer, and they reclassify no frozen gate.

population_coverage_useful_independently.why: P2 is the immutable parent residual projector inherited from FCRA00. Whether its inherited tube covers fresh ancestries is a question about the PARENT BASIS, not about the NEAR/FAR x carrier interaction. It would remain worth asking had the differential axis never been attempted.

one_ancestry_level_score_fixed_by_the_cl.why: the claim fixes the score, not the data. If the claim is robustness across NEAR/FAR x allocation, the frozen ancestry score is the MAXIMUM of its four cell scores; if the claim were average behaviour it would be the mean. These answer different questions and the choice is made by the claim, never by outcomes.
one_ancestry_level_score_fixed_by_the_cl.independent_unit: one upstream ancestry block, as the committed factor graph already declares

target_coverage_and_loss_function_justif.why: the tube's nominal marginal coverage is 4/5 EXACTLY by exchangeability of its four calibration scores - a mathematical property of the construction, not a chosen number. A preplan can therefore test the inherited tube against its own construction-implied coverage without ever consulting how many historical scores exceeded it.
target_coverage_and_loss_function_justif.explicitly_left_open: the scientific loss function and any tolerance below 4/5 must be written down by the owner before values, not selected afterwards

calibration_and_evaluation_roles_max_sam.why: all four are design objects derivable as mathematics only. Sample size follows from the exchangeability model above; roles and stopping are declarations.

distinction_between_testing_the_inherite.testing_the_inherited_tube: estimates the coverage of the FIXED tube built from the existing four calibration scores. This is the transfer question.
distinction_between_testing_the_inherite.calibrating_a_new_tube: builds a fresh tube around the same P2 basis from new calibration ancestries. It can always be made to cover by construction and therefore CANNOT prove transfer of the inherited tube. The two must never be reported as one result.

standing_caveats: this eligibility is METHODOLOGICAL. Execution would require a fresh owner authorization and a fresh seed namespace; FCDDH01R granted exactly one panel and is closed.
three historical exceedances among twelve are ordinary under exchangeability (E[K] = 12/5, P(K >= 3) = 11/28 ~ 0.393) and establish nothing about population non-transfer by themselves.
this route is NOT an axis rescue and cannot revive the fixed-support differential axis.

one_physical_rationale_already_present_i.why: no committed object forces a unique physical estimand independently of the fixed-support failure. Conservation-compatible boundary transport at an independently fixed spatial scale is structurally admissible as a CLASS, but the record does not single out one field, domain, support, sign, null, time set, weight, centering, gauge and normalization before values.
